skills.description: Create an editable moment (clip) from an ingested video via the Montage MCP tools and deliver an editor link. Use after video ingestion when the user wants a clip/moment created from their video.

skills.description_zh: 在视频已导入后，通过 Montage MCP 创建可编辑的片段或 moment，并交付编辑器链接。
